_comment: Two-coder topology (2026-10-12, bead 4f81): Qwen3-Coder-Next on the box (llama.cpp Vulkan) and on the Mac (MLX 4-bit, mlx_lm.server :8085 held by scripts/ops/keepalive-mac.sh). Same tier/capacity/weight, so unpinned agentic work and role=code round-robin across both machines. json_schema requests and tokenize go to coder-box only. Measurements: T2 coder-next-m4max-mlx-vs-metal-2026-10-11.

backends._comment: expected_build pins the health probe to the coder-box llama-server build: /props build_info must contain it, else a different build answering on this port reports unhealthy.

model must be default_model: mlx_lm.server loads whatever model a request names, and default_model is the one it was started with (the keepalive starts it from a pinned snapshot path). no_schema: MLX ignores response_format.json_schema. no_tokenize: MLX has no /tokenize.
